WELCOME RACE FANS!
On behalf of over 500 members of Eastern Wisconsin Stock Cars, we would like to welcome
you to Sheboygan County Fairgrounds. The quarter-mile Plymouth race track is one of the best
dirt tracks in Wisconsin.
We run three classes of competition: The open-wheeled Modified, the late-model-appearing
Sportsmen, and the fender-bending Hobby Stocks.
We hope you enjoy our race program and will come back and visit us often. Please support
our program's advertisers as they made this book possible. Tell them you saw their ad in our
program.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact any member at the track, or write Eastern
Wisconsin Stock Cars, Inc., P.O. Box 47, Plymouth, WI 53073.
Thank you and enjoy the evening.
